title: Legal English onset-cluster table
spec_reference: Section 9 (Deterministic Maximum Onset Principle against fixed legal-onset table); Section 17 F5
required_source_material: A standard English phonotactics reference giving the exhaustive inventory of legal word-initial (syllable-onset) consonant clusters, transcribed so that it can be mapped one-to-one onto the ARPAbet consonant symbols in fixtures/lexicon/cmudict.symbols.

Section 17 F5 names the requirement as 'a standard phonotactics reference' without naming a specific work; the reference to be used must be chosen and recorded before this fixture is populated, because the onset inventory chosen determines every syllable boundary the experiment produces.
population_instructions: onsets: a list of ARPAbet consonant sequences that may open a syllable, including all singleton onsets that occur, all two-consonant clusters, and all three-consonant clusters.
Each entry must carry a 'source' field naming the reference and its table or page.

The table is consumed by Maximum Onset Principle syllabification: of the consonants between two vowels, the LONGEST suffix that appears in this table becomes the following syllable's onset and the remainder becomes the preceding syllable's coda.

Do NOT derive this table from CMUdict word-initial frequency counts as a substitute. A frequency-derived inventory is a different object from a phonotactic inventory: it admits accidental gaps as illegal and rare loans as legal, and the resulting syllable boundaries would silently differ from the specified ones.
A cluster absent from this table is a HARD ERROR at syllabification, never a silent default.
